bug_description.original:
Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=6109218488582144

Project: flac
Fuzzing Engine: libFuzzer
Fuzz Target: fuzzer_tool_flac
Job Type: libfuzzer_msan_flac

Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value
Crash State: write_callback -> write_audio_frame_to_client_ -> read_frame_
bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json / reproduction_report.json / sanitizer_trace.txt / patch.diff / staged vulnerable source under gt_results/arvo_63790/_work/src/flac
bug_description.normalized: The staged 248-byte witness drives both CLI option state and file metadata through `oss-fuzz/tool_flac.c`: its zero-delimited prefix yields `-Fd`, `--force-e`, and `--keep-foreign-metadata`, so `parse_options()` sets decode mode, `force_extensible_wave_format`, and `keep_foreign_metadata`. The remaining bytes are written to the temp file and `flac__foreign_metadata_read_from_flac()` recovers AIFF foreign metadata whose first saved chunk begins `FORM ... AIFC`, so `decode_file()` selects `output_format = FORMAT_AIFF_C`. Vulnerable `decode_file()` then handles `--force-extensible-wave-format` by setting only `output_subformat = SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE` and not resetting `output_format` to `FORMAT_WAVE`. That impossible pair is passed into `flac__decode_file()`, which stack-allocates `DecoderSession decoder_session`; because the effective `options.format` is not `FORMAT_RAW`, the raw-only initializer never writes `decoder_session.is_big_endian`. In `write_callback()`, the AIFF-C plus WAVE-extensible combination misses both AIFF-C special cases and the fallback arm propagates `decoder_session->is_big_endian` into local `is_big_endian`. The saved MSAN report then fires at `decode.c:1263` when the stereo 16-bit fast-path condition reads that uninitialized scalar.

source.description: First project-side parser step on the vulnerable path. `parse_options()` consumes the zero-delimited CLI prefix from the staged witness and materializes the short/long option events later converted into decode mode, forced wave-extensible output, and foreign-metadata restoration.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` is 248 bytes with SHA-256 `dedd232ac15488de61659230216bed71273bb08cf62de95233eac2e76016dd4d`. In `oss-fuzz/tool_flac.c:60-82`, byte 0 (`0x06`) becomes `maxarg = 6`, the following zero-delimited strings are scanned into `argv[]`, and the remaining bytes are written to the temp file that becomes the positional input. The relevant parsed prefix strings are `-Fd`, `--force-e`, and `--keep-foreign-metadata`; GNU `share__getopt_long` accepts the unique long-option abbreviation `--force-e` for `--force-extensible-wave-format`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. After foreign metadata has already selected `output_format = FORMAT_AIFF_C`, the forced extensible-wave branch changes only `output_subformat` and leaves `output_format` untouched, creating the impossible pair `(FORMAT_AIFF_C, SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE)`.
root_cause.note: The staged patch fixes this exact obligation by adding `output_format = FORMAT_WAVE` in both `force_legacy_wave_format` and `force_extensible_wave_format` branches before assigning the WAVE subformat.

sink.description: MSAN crash site. The fast-path condition reads local `is_big_endian`; on the witnessed path that local still contains the fallback from uninitialized `decoder_session->is_big_endian`.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer report is `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `write_callback /src/flac/oss-fuzz/../src/flac/decode.c:1263:49`, and it attributes the origin to stack allocation of `decoder_session` in `flac__decode_file`.

tainted_value_origin.description: The sink-reaching uninitialized state lives in stack object `decoder_session`, specifically its `is_big_endian` field. Because later logic only initializes that raw-output state under `if(options.format == FORMAT_RAW)`, the witnessed non-raw AIFF-C/WAVE-extensible path leaves the field indeterminate until `write_callback()` consumes it.

parser_admitted.description: File-format admission point for the foreign-metadata side of the witness path. After `decode_file()` enables restoration with `--keep-foreign-metadata`, the first FLAC APPLICATION block is accepted as AIFF foreign metadata because the saved payload begins `FORM ... AIFC`.

coarse_trace.summary: The zero-delimited witness prefix is parsed as CLI options, materializing decode mode plus the forced wave-extensible and keep-foreign-metadata flags.
Because foreign-metadata restoration is enabled, the decoder reads saved AIFF-C metadata out of the FLAC file and classifies it as AIFF family with `is_aifc = true`.

`decode_file()` first selects `FORMAT_AIFF_C` from the recovered metadata and then applies `--force-extensible-wave-format` by changing only the subformat, leaving an impossible `FORMAT_AIFF_C` plus `SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE` pair.
The inconsistent pair reaches a stack `DecoderSession`; because the effective format is not raw, the raw-output endian fields stay uninitialized.

`write_callback()` falls back to `decoder_session->is_big_endian` for the impossible AIFF-C/WAVE-extensible combination, and the stereo 16-bit fast-path test at line 1263 reads that uninitialized scalar.

fine_trace.note: The CLI front end is the first project parser on this path. The harness turns the staged witness into `argv[]` by taking byte 0 as `maxarg`, scanning zero-delimited strings, and appending a temp filename; `share__getopt_long` then materializes the option events later handled as `-d`, `--force-extensible-wave-format` (from unique abbreviation `--force-e`), and `--keep-foreign-metadata`.

When the parser reaches short option `d` from the `-Fd` token, it switches the program into decode mode. That control state is what later makes `do_it()` invoke `decode_file()` on the temp file instead of the encode path.
The unique long-option abbreviation `--force-e` is resolved to `force-extensible-wave-format`, so this handler sets the flag that later forces `output_subformat = SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE`.
The long option `--keep-foreign-metadata` enables the decode path that reads saved WAVE/AIFF chunks back out of the FLAC file and uses them to choose the output container.

Once decode mode and foreign-metadata restoration have reached `decode_file()`, the foreign-metadata reader examines the first FLAC APPLICATION block. The staged file contains application-id bytes `aiff`, so this loop classifies the saved foreign metadata as AIFF-family data by setting `fm->type = FOREIGN_BLOCK_TYPE__AIFF`.

In that same first foreign-metadata block, the saved payload begins `FORM ... AIFC`, so the AIFF branch sets `fm->is_aifc = true`. This refines the attacker-controlled metadata state from generic AIFF to AIFF-C.

Back in `decode_file()`, foreign-metadata selection uses the recovered AIFF-family state. It first chooses `FORMAT_AIFF` and then upgrades to `FORMAT_AIFF_C` because step 6 marked the saved foreign metadata as AIFF-C.

Root cause. This branch honors the forced WAVE subformat from step 3 but does not also reset `output_format`, so the AIFF-C choice from step 7 survives and the function leaves the impossible pair `(FORMAT_AIFF_C, SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE)` in place.

Before calling this function, `decode_file()` copies step 8's `output_subformat` and step 7's `output_format` into `decode_options.force_subformat` and `decode_options.format` at `main.c:2356,2363`, then reaches the non-raw call site at `main.c:2380`; ordinary call plumbing is omitted here. `flac__decode_file()` now stack-allocates `decoder_session`, whose `is_big_endian` and `is_unsigned_samples` fields start indeterminate. MSAN later names this stack object as the origin of the uninitialized value.

The only explicit initialization of `decoder_session.is_big_endian` and `decoder_session.is_unsigned_samples` is guarded by `options.format == FORMAT_RAW`. On the witnessed path the effective `options.format` from step 7 is `FORMAT_AIFF_C`, so this block is skipped and the raw-output fields remain as the indeterminate stack contents from step 9.

The local endian flag is derived from the session's format/subformat pair. `FORMAT_AIFF_C` with `SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE` matches neither AIFF-C special case (`SUBFORMAT_AIFF_C_NONE` nor `SUBFORMAT_AIFF_C_SOWT`), so the final fallback arm copies `decoder_session->is_big_endian`. That makes local `is_big_endian` uninitialized on the witnessed path. The separate `is_unsigned_samples` expression immediately below still resolves deterministically to `false` for `FORMAT_AIFF_C`.

MSAN sink. The stereo 16-bit fast-path test reads local `is_big_endian` at `is_big_endian == is_big_endian_host_`. Because step 11 propagated the still-uninitialized fallback value from `decoder_session->is_big_endian`, MemorySanitizer reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` here and attributes the origin to the stack `decoder_session` allocation in `flac__decode_file`.

allocation_context.note: The saved MSAN origin says the uninitialized value was created by allocation of `decoder_session` in the stack frame of `flac__decode_file` at line 136; the declaration itself is at line 137.

sanitizer_ground_truth.source: parsed from staged sanitizer_trace.txt, default_crash_trace.txt, reproduction_report.json, patch.diff, and staged vulnerable source

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: Indirectly. MSAN names the later stack allocation of `decoder_session` in `flac__decode_file`, while the source-level missing obligation is earlier in `decode_file()`: it leaves `output_format` as `FORMAT_AIFF_C` while forcing a WAVE subformat, which is what causes the allocated session's raw-endian field to remain uninitialized and later reach the sink.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged patch changes the exact root-cause branches in `decode_file()` so `force_legacy_wave_format` and `force_extensible_wave_format` both also set `output_format = FORMAT_WAVE`. That removes the impossible `FORMAT_AIFF_C` plus WAVE-subformat pair that previously forced `write_callback()` to fall back to `decoder_session->is_big_endian`. Stage 02 did not perform fixed-version dynamic validation.

poc.trigger: Running the staged witness with `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_63790 run --version vulnerable --expect crash` reproduces `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` in `write_callback` with the saved FLAC decode stack.

format.name: Zero-delimited `tool_flac` argv prefix plus FLAC file bytes
format.contract: The witnessed trigger is the exact 248-byte staged `poc` (SHA-256 `dedd232ac15488de61659230216bed71273bb08cf62de95233eac2e76016dd4d`). Under `oss-fuzz/tool_flac.c`, byte 0 is `0x06`, so the next zero-delimited strings become CLI arguments before the remaining bytes are written to the temp input file. On the saved path the relevant strings are `-Fd`, an empty entry, `--force-e`, another empty entry, and `--keep-foreign-metadata`; GNU `share__getopt_long` treats `--force-e` as the unique abbreviation for `--force-extensible-wave-format`. The temp file bytes begin with `fLaC` and include saved foreign-metadata application blocks whose visible payload strings include `aiffFORM    AIFC`, `aiffCOMM`, and `aiffSSND`, so `flac__foreign_metadata_read_from_flac()` reconstructs AIFF-C metadata. The trigger therefore requires this exact combination of decode mode, forced extensible-wave subformat, foreign-metadata restoration, and an input FLAC file whose preserved foreign metadata is recognized as AIFF-C. This contract is limited to the staged witness layout and observed path, not all abbreviated options or all FLAC files with foreign metadata.
